description: vsftpd 2.3.4 as distributed on some mirrors contains a backdoor that opens a shell on port 6200 when a username containing ':)' is supplied.
ProFTPD 1.3.3c mod_copy module contains a backdoor allowing unauthenticated remote command execution.
OpenSSH 7.2 has a timing side-channel in password authentication that allows remote username enumeration.
OpenSSH before 7.4 can load a PKCS#11 module from a forwarded agent socket, allowing remote code execution against ssh-agent.
Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal flaw that can lead to remote code execution if CGI scripts are enabled.
Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 — Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 remains exploitable for path traversal and remote code execution.
nginx chunked transfer-encoding handling has a stack buffer overflow that can lead to remote code execution.
IIS 6.0 WebDAV ScStoragePathFromUrl function has a buffer overflow allowing remote code execution.
MySQL/MariaDB versions built against certain libc implementations can be tricked into accepting an incorrect password due to a memcmp() return-value assumption bug.
Legacy Postfix 2.x branch is end-of-life; confirm patch level, TLS configuration, and open-relay status manually.
